evals.prompt: What is this agent currently reporting as its Tariboy progress status?
evals.expected_output: Runs `scripts/status.sh` and returns the current one-line status.
expectations: Uses the status script without `set` to read the current status.
Reports the status as a one-line progress value.

evals.prompt: Publish this progress update: 'reviewing the retry path'. Keep working afterward.
evals.expected_output: Runs `scripts/status.sh set "reviewing the retry path"` and continues the iteration.
expectations: Uses the status script's set command with the supplied one-line update.
Does not signal iteration completion merely by updating status.

evals.prompt: Set my status to a detailed 50-line retrospective and have that status change finish the iteration automatically.
evals.expected_output: Keeps any status update to a one-line progress summary and explains that completion requires the loop skill instead.
expectations: Does not use the status field as a multi-line retrospective.
Does not treat a status update as the iteration completion action.
